CWE-327-WEAK.name: Weak TLS Configuration (Weak Cipher Suites)
CWE-327-WEAK.impact: Outdated TLS 1.0/1.1 or weak cipher suites vulnerable to known attacks (POODLE, BEAST, Heartbleed)
CWE-327-WEAK.business_impact: Cryptographic weakness, Man-in-the-Middle attacks, data interception
fix_steps: 1. Audit current TLS configuration using: openssl s_client -connect hostname:443 -tls1_2
2. Or use: nmap --script ssl-enum-ciphers -p 443 hostname
3. Disable weak protocols: Remove support for TLS 1.0, TLS 1.1, and SSL 3.0
4. Configure strong cipher suites only - use ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384 or ECDHE-RSA-CHACHA20-POLY1305
5. For Nginx: ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3; ssl_ciphers HIGH:!aNULL:!MD5;
6. For Apache: SSLProtocol -all +TLSv1.2 +TLSv1.3 and SSLCipherSuite 'ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384'
7. Use Mozilla SSL Configuration Generator (https://ssl-config.mozilla.org) for best practices
8. Enable HSTS: Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains
9. Test with SSL Labs (https://www.ssllabs.com/ssltest) - aim for A+ grade
10. Verify no weak ciphers appear in SSL Labs results
11. Re-run vulnerability scan to confirm remediation

code_examples.apache:
# /etc/apache2/mods-available/ssl.conf
SSLProtocol -all +TLSv1.2 +TLSv1.3
SSLCipherSuite 'ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384:ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:ECDHE-RSA-CHACHA20-POLY1305'
Header always set Strict-Transport-Security 'max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains'
code_examples.test_command:
# Verify configuration
openssl s_client -connect hostname:443 -tls1_2
nmap --script ssl-enum-ciphers -p 443 hostname
curl -I --tlsv1.1 https://hostname  # Should fail
curl -I --tlsv1.2 https://hostname  # Should succeed
